annotations.title: VAT rates by country (Europe and Latin America)

description: Return the standard and reduced VAT rates of one country, or the European table when country is omitted. Covers EU-27 plus UK, CH, NO and 17 Latin American countries. Use vat_price to apply a European rate to an amount, latam_iva to calculate Latin American VAT, and vat_validate to check a VAT number. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /vat/rates via x402.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, FR, CL, MX. Omit for the European table.
